WITH city_counts AS (
    SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN zip_code AS z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    GROUP BY z.city
),
city_shares AS (
    SELECT city, attendance_count,
           1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM city_counts
),
city_averages AS (
    SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM city_shares
)
SELECT AVG(attendance_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM city_averages
WHERE share > average_share;
